articles.headline: All 24 Indian crew rescued from tanker set ablaze off Oman after US strike
articles.summary: Crew members of the unladen tanker had sent distress messages saying the vessel was on fire and sinking.
articles._summary: All 24 Indian seafarers aboard a tanker that caught fire off the coast of Oman after being struck by US forces have been rescued and evacuated safely, Indian authorities said. Crew members of the unladen tanker had sent distress messages saying the vessel was on fire and sinking. Monday's incident is the latest involving commercial shipping in Gulf waters, where the Iran war and US-led enforcement measures have sharply increased risks to maritime traffic. It comes against the backdrop of tensions involving Iran, the US and Israel, which have disrupted shipping routes and increased military activity in and around the Gulf of Oman and the Strait of Hormuz. A fire broke out on the tanker MT Marivex at about 1330 local time while 24 Indian sailors were on board, Opesh Kumar Sharma of India's ministry of ports, shipping and waterways told reporters on Monday.
articles._zh_headline: 美国袭击后阿曼附近油轮起火，24名印度船员全部获救
articles._zh_summary: 印度当局表示，一艘在阿曼海岸被美军击中后起火的油轮上的所有 24 名印度海员均已获救并安全撤离。这艘空载油轮的船员已发出求救信息，称该船着火并正在下沉。周一的事件是涉及海湾水域商业航运的最新一起事件，伊朗战争和美国主导的执法措施大幅增加了海上交通的风险。这是在伊朗、美国和以色列关系紧张的背景下进行的，这些紧张局势扰乱了阿曼湾和霍尔木兹海峡及其周边地区的航线，并增加了军事活动。印度港口、航运和航道部的奥佩什·库马尔·夏尔马 (Opesh Kumar Sharma) 周一告诉记者，当地时间 1330 点左右，MT Marivex 号油轮发生火灾，船上有 24 名印度水手。

articles.headline: Stock Market: Will S&P 500 Open Up Or Down Today?
articles.summary: June 9, 2026: Polymarket traders turn bullish on the S&P 500 on Tuesday as chip stocks rebound and futures advance.
articles._summary: The S&P 500 climbed on Monday as semiconductor stocks rebounded from last week’s sharp selloff and Polymarket traders are betting the benchmark index will build on those gains at Tuesday’s open. The S&P 500 rose 0.30% to close at 7,405.73 on Monday, recovering some ground after Friday’s tech-driven rout triggered by a hotter-than-expected May jobs report. The June 9 Polymarket contract implied an 89% probability that the index will open higher on Tuesday.

articles.headline: Watch: Trump tells BBC Netanyahu did not defy him
articles.summary: In a call with the US president, the BBC’s Sarah Smith asked Trump about the war in Iran and his relationship with the Israeli leader.
articles._summary: The BBC’s North America Editor Sarah Smith spoke with President Donald Trump in a brief phone call on Monday about his conversations with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu leading up to strikes on Iran. When asked if Netanyahu defied him by firing at Iran on Sunday, Trump said the missiles were “already on their way” when he spoke with the Israeli prime minister. He added, “if I tell him to do something, he does it.” The call lasted just under a minute. The BBC's international editor, Jeremy Bowen, said the public are "right to be worried" as the consequences of the war will be felt for generations. BBC correspondent John Sudworth reports from the Beirut stronghold of Hezbollah support, Dahieh. One person was killed and more than 60 injured in the Iranian drone strike on Wednesday. Verified videos show strikes on densely populated neighbourhoods in southern Lebanon.

articles._zh_summary: 英国广播公司北美编辑莎拉·史密斯周一与唐纳德·特朗普总统进行了简短的电话交谈，谈论了他与以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡在袭击伊朗之前的谈话。当被问及内塔尼亚胡是否违抗他周日向伊朗开火时，特朗普表示，当他与以色列总理交谈时，导弹“已经在路上”。他补充道，“如果我告诉他做某事，他就会做。”通话持续了不到一分钟。英国广播公司(BBC)国际编辑杰里米·鲍文(Jeremy Bowen)表示，公众“担心是有道理的”，因为战争的后果将影响几代人。 BBC 记者约翰·萨德沃斯 (John Sudworth) 从贝鲁特支持真主党的大本营达希 (Dahieh) 进行报道。周三，伊朗无人机袭击造成 1 人死亡、60 多人受伤。经核实的视频显示，黎巴嫩南部人口稠密的社区遭到袭击。

articles.author: Opeyemi Babalola
articles.headline: Nvidia: Why Jensen Huang's Buy The Sell-off Remark Is A Grounded Structural Argument
articles.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang called the tech selloff a buying opportunity on June 8. Here is what that means for investors.
articles._summary: Huang's buying-opportunity call is not a forecast. It is a structural argument grounded in revenue acceleration, supply chain deepening, and a product cycle that is only beginning to ramp. The macro risk is real. Stronger jobs data and a hawkish Fed are not trivial headwinds for a stock trading at elevated multiples. However, investors separating noise from signal will note that Nvidia's fundamentals have not deteriorated.
articles._zh_headline: 英伟达：为什么黄仁勋的买入抛售言论是有根据的结构性论点
articles._zh_summary: 黄的买入机会呼吁并非预测。这是一个结构性论点，其基础是收入加速、供应链深化以及刚刚开始加速的产品周期。宏观风险是真实存在的。对于市盈率较高的股票来说，强劲的就业数据和鹰派的美联储并不是微不足道的阻力。然而，将噪音与信号分开的投资者会注意到，英伟达的基本面并未恶化。
